Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Molecule Dictionary, Compound Structures. Join: Activities to Molecule Dictionary on molregno. Molecule Dictionary to Compound Structures on molregno. Filter: assay_id corresponds to chembl_id CHEMBL1054504. standard_value is not null. standard_relation equals '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ascending, chembl_id ascending, standard_type ascending, standard_relation ascending, standard_value ascending, standard_units ascending.
